markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set, second-model agreement and 4 of 5 similar cases support it [F1][F5].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu 0% | Clear top class |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | Reliability 100%; OOD percentile 100 | No input warning |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 4 of 5 Invasive | One InSitu neighbor |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Low score; largest concept-model term, failed spot check [F2] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Score typical; concept-model term leans invasive [F4] · Validated
- **Frequent mitoses** (regions 5, 8, 9) · ↑ invasive · High score; 0/20 spot check · Unreliable
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · High score, but concept-model term near zero · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Top-3 region deletion drops invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Concept deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0: not shown to reflect the classifier. Leans on Unreliable normal lobules and mitoses.

## Could be wrong if
- Reliability score ranks errors only modestly (AUROC 0.69); high reliability is weak reassurance.
- Degraded frozen-section simulation (resample, severity 3); closest InSitu neighbor BACH_0160 has similarity 0.79.

## Check on the slide
1. **0** Look for residual normal lobules; the low normal-lobule score failed its spot check.
2. **2, 5, 8, 9** Verify mitoses and necrosis directly; both failed AI spot checks.
3. **0–3, 8–11** Confirm tumor at superior and inferior margins [F7].
